name: krushimitra-ai
description: KrushiMitra AI — Agriculture Shop Billing, Inventory & Management Software
author: KrushiMitra

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -k -n FRONT,BACK -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k -n FRONT,BACK,ELECTRON -c cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:preview: npm run electron:build:frontend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
